text:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the scope and launch gates for the new API changes (chat/completions + embeddings + rerank adjustments). VaultHealth and Lumin pushed for stronger latency SLAs and deterministic rerank. Need clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a minimal cut for launch. @Diego @Riley can you 👍 or propose cuts?

Diego (Backend Eng): TL;DR: agree on two slices — (A) Feature-complete: rerank + embed hybrid + per-request SLAs; (B) Minimal launch: keep current rerank, expose embed-only endpoint w/ new quotas. Minimal reduces infra risk. Also need fallback policy to cheaper model when GPU contention.

Riley (ML Eng): +1 to slices. For deterministic rerank we need consistent scoring seeds and fixed sampling off. Also note edge-case: very long contexts (>=32k tokens) break KV-cache assumptions and change latency profile.

Ava (PM): Good. We should list acceptance criteria for both slices. I'll draft and iterate. Preliminary idea:
- Minimal (B) acceptance: embed endpoint stable for 95th p95 <= 120ms internal; rerank unchanged; docs + SDK example; rollout can be phased.
- Feature-complete (A) acceptance: rerank determinism validated on 5 customer prompt sets; commit to p99 SLA <= 600ms for 8k tokens; fallback to low-cost model with observable quality delta.

Sam (Design): Need clear API contract examples for both. Small ask: provide sample response JSON for a rerank deterministic mode and one for weighted hybrid rerank. I'll add mocks.

Nadia (Customer Success): From VaultHealth: they need stable top-1 recall for their clinical search. They asked for a canary with production mirror and a rollback plan. Lumin cares more about cost per call and will accept slightly higher latency if cost drops by 30%.

Diego (Backend Eng): Operational checklist items:
- autoscale policy for dedicated pools (+burst config)
- route policy: prefer cheaper regional variant when p95 breach detected
- telemetry: per-request model variant + token counts + rerank seed in logs
- rollback: force-route to previous model id, invalidate caches
Snippet for route policy config we discussed:
```yaml
route_policy:
  - when: p95_latency > 500ms
    action: route_to: cheap-variant
    grace_period: 60s
```

Riley (ML Eng): Edge cases I want documented:
- input permutations that trigger numeric instability in quantized kernels
- very short prompts causing rerank score ties (need tie-break deterministic rule)
- embeddings drift when model is updated — require embedding drift eval and baseline rollback threshold (e.g., cosine drop > 0.07)

Ava (PM): Action items — I'll own PRD draft + acceptance table. Diego/Riley to add technical checklist and edge-case examples by EOD. Sam to upload UX mocks. Nadia will coordinate VaultHealth canary and acceptance test sets. ops-bot: create canary channel and tracking ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-2147 and channel #canary-vaulthealth.

Diego (Backend Eng): One more callout — quantization recommendation: start with int8 for embeddings, keep rerank float16 for determinism. Document expected perf delta.

Riley (ML Eng): I'll provide a small eval harness (5k queries) to validate determinism and p99 on cached vs uncached. Will attach results to the PRD.

Ava (PM): Thanks — next sync tomorrow 10am. If anyone objects to slices A/B, flag now. :thumbsup:
